# id: PG-pg-84-balance-medic
# covers: PG 191 (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Beaks + Avarek)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 36D7474D+ (pg_statprobe), harness c5a5c88+ (give artifacts, research start any; 90a0e33: teleport moved=/bed, speed hold) (KAH 24: chance, detect, detecttime, healtime, findwater, swimtime, construct, construction); client kah.py from the harness repo (LONG_COMMANDS has the KAH 24 timers); set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest
# design: Avarek (medic, 5 Basic First Aid Kits) treats Beaks: per point healtime ... wound 30 gives Beaks full
#   health, no bandages and the same three cuts, then times the first aid at speed 1. Beaks is NOT
#   protected while treated (protect heals wounds). Result = bandaging added per game second.
# verify: finished=1 in every point; own50 > none = first aid reads the hooked Medic.
#   Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv; python3 tools/analyze_balance.py balance.csv
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 4
speed 0
protect Beaks on
protect Avarek on
hunger Avarek 280
hunger Beaks 280
select Avarek
clearjobs Avarek
pg_statprobe on Avarek
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 4 ~ moved=1
protect Beaks off
give Beaks "Basic First Aid Kit" 1
drop Beaks "Basic First Aid Kit"
give Beaks "Standard First Aid Kit" 1
drop Beaks "Standard First Aid Kit"
give Avarek "Basic First Aid Kit" 1
drop Avarek "Basic First Aid Kit"
give Avarek "Standard First Aid Kit" 1
drop Avarek "Standard First Aid Kit"
inv Beaks
inv Avarek
speed 1 hold
!healtime Avarek Beaks wound 30 timeout 60 ~ finished=0 .*bandaging 0\.0+ -> 0\.0+
speed 0
@echo BAL2,191,medic,0,0,nokit,w0,heal_control,0,bandaging 0 -> 0,-
pg_statprobe read
give Avarek "Basic First Aid Kit" 5
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 4 ~ moved=1
give Avarek "Iron Hat" 1
equip Avarek "Iron Hat"
pg_info Avarek "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
# --- d1 diagnostic: skill 10, wound 60, Basic kit only ---
setstat Avarek medic 10
give Avarek "Basic First Aid Kit" 1
drop Avarek "Basic First Aid Kit"
give Avarek "Standard First Aid Kit" 1
drop Avarek "Standard First Aid Kit"
give Avarek "Basic First Aid Kit" 1
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 4 ~ moved=1
@echo READY
where Avarek ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
inv Avarek ~ Basic First Aid Kit
speed 1 hold
@set H healtime Avarek Beaks wound 60 timeout 600 ~ (seconds_bandaging=[\d.]+ bandaging [\d.]+ -> [\d.]+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,191,medic_diag_basic_cut60,10,0,none,d1,heal,0,${H},-
pg_statprobe read
hunger Avarek 280
# --- d2 diagnostic: skill 90, wound 60, Basic kit only ---
setstat Avarek medic 90
give Avarek "Basic First Aid Kit" 1
drop Avarek "Basic First Aid Kit"
give Avarek "Standard First Aid Kit" 1
drop Avarek "Standard First Aid Kit"
give Avarek "Basic First Aid Kit" 1
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 4 ~ moved=1
@echo READY
where Avarek ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
inv Avarek ~ Basic First Aid Kit
speed 1 hold
@set H healtime Avarek Beaks wound 60 timeout 600 ~ (seconds_bandaging=[\d.]+ bandaging [\d.]+ -> [\d.]+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,191,medic_diag_basic_cut60,90,0,none,d2,heal,0,${H},-
pg_statprobe read
hunger Avarek 280
# --- d3 diagnostic: skill 90, wound 30, Standard kit only ---
setstat Avarek medic 90
give Avarek "Basic First Aid Kit" 1
drop Avarek "Basic First Aid Kit"
give Avarek "Standard First Aid Kit" 1
drop Avarek "Standard First Aid Kit"

speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0

speed 0
@echo BAL2,191,medic_diag_standard_cut30,90,0,none,d3,heal,0,${H},-
pg_statprobe read
hunger Avarek 280
give Avarek "Basic First Aid Kit" 1
drop Avarek "Basic First Aid Kit"
give Avarek "Standard First Aid Kit" 1
drop Avarek "Standard First Aid Kit"
give Avarek "Basic First Aid Kit" 5
# --- w1: skill 10, gear none ---
